Give more of your own ground to the one you hold with Sarah on your right: what the two of you weave together widens. It is 17 warps wide now.
Give Amanda some of your ground on your left, freely. You hold 19 warps; Amanda holds 18.
Press into Amanda's ground on your left and take some of it. Amanda holds 18 warps; you hold 19.
